title: Mastering the ABCDs of Complex Questions: Answer-Based Claim Decomposition for Fine-grained Self-Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating factual truthfulness and hallucination in LLMs, not directly benchmarking or evaluating religion, morals, or ethics. An example in the error analysis involving 'Christianity' (Table 2) is used to illustrate complex reasoning failure, not to benchmark religious or ethical understanding.
